details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3389-3393 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-tree HEAD HEAD` capability probe uses invalid syntax and can never succeed.
  WHY: x-ai says the self-check fails syntactically and the probe always falls through to dispatch; qwen treated the surrounding fail-open behavior as intentional, but not this call shape.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3398-3419 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight probe appears to check the wrong merge direction, so clean default-to-integration syncs can be treated as conflicts.
  WHY: x-ai says the `git merge-tree` call is probing the opposite direction and would false-negative clean merges; qwen disagreed with that interpretation.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3403-3406 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The recovery path clears sync state but leaves `integration_conflict_total_dispatches` intact.
  WHY: x-ai says the cap check can re-fire immediately after recovery because the counter is not reset.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3406-3422 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight merge probe runs even when the sync state is already clean, so non-conflict `mergeable=false` cases can be marked clean and bypass healing.
  WHY: Deepseek says a clean `git merge-tree` result on a non-conflict `mergeable=false` PR clears state and returns 0, permanently bypassing dispatch/cooldown/judge escalation until the GitHub signal changes.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3406 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only --no-messages HEAD HEAD` self-capability check assumes `HEAD` is a valid tree-ish.
  WHY: Minimax says exotic runner or repository states could make the probe fail unexpectedly, though the flow fail-opens to the existing dispatch path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3417-3419 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight probe log message states the merge direction backwards.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers said the echo text can mislead incident response about which branch is being merged; severity was disputed between cosmetic/operator-confusion and higher-priority debugging impact.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3409-3411 + 3351-3353 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight merge probe duplicates the same fetch logic already used by `_list_integration_conflict_files`.
  WHY: Deepseek says a call that reaches the dispatch path performs two identical `git fetch` operations for the same refs; it is operational waste only.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3387-3419 vs 3359-3368 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight merge probe duplicates the fetch and `git merge-tree` logic already implemented in `_list_integration_conflict_files`.
  WHY: Minimax says the two code paths do the same fetch and merge-tree check, which risks drift but is not a correctness bug.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3386-3423 and 3340-3378 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight merge probe duplicates the git fetch and merge-tree logic already implemented in `_list_integration_conflict_files`.
  WHY: z-ai says the probe and helper both fetch the same refs and run `git merge-tree`, causing a duplicated fetch per invocation that is inefficient but not a correctness issue.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3465-3471 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `mark_integration_sync_clean` clears sync state on mergeable recovery but leaves `integration_conflict_total_dispatches` unchanged.
  WHY: Deepseek says a stale mergeable=true signal can leave the counter at the cap and immediately re-enter the cap check on the next tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3465-3476 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `_has_active_autofix_run` deferral has no counter or timeout, so a stuck autofix run can defer terminalization indefinitely.
  WHY: Each poll tick returns 0 while an active run is reported; qwen argued the external job timeout bounds this, but the other reviewers flagged the in-code deferral loop as unbounded.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3653-3669 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `mark_integration_sync_clean` does not reset `integration_conflict_total_dispatches`.
  WHY: Minimax says the function only clears sync status and unresolved ticks, so a later real conflict can re-hit the lifetime cap immediately.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3406-3422 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight merge probe fires unconditionally at the top of heal_integration_branch_conflict, so non-conflict mergeable=false states can be marked clean and the healing pipeline is bypassed.
  WHY: When mergeable=false comes from required checks or other non-conflict causes, git merge-tree can still report clean and the function returns 0, preventing dispatch/cooldown/judge escalation.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3473-3476 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The _has_active_autofix_run deferral has no counter or timeout, so a stuck autofix run can keep terminalization deferred indefinitely.
  WHY: Each poll tick returns 0 while an active run is reported, with no bound on repeated deferrals.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3465-3471 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When the mergeable=true recovery path marks integration sync clean, it does not reset integration_conflict_total_dispatches.
  WHY: If the GitHub mergeable signal is stale, the next tick can re-enter the cap check with the dispatch counter still at the limit.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3409-3411 + 3351-3353 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight merge probe duplicates the same git fetch logic already performed by _list_integration_conflict_files.
  WHY: A heal_integration_branch_conflict invocation that reaches the dispatch path performs two identical fetches for the same refs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3419 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The log message states the merge direction backwards.
  WHY: The log text says the default branch merges into the integration branch, which can mislead operators during incident response.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3473-3476 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Deferring terminalization whenever _has_active_autofix_run reports an active run has no timeout or counter.
  WHY: Every poll tick that finds an active autofix run returns 0 without any bound on how many times this can happen.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3653-3669 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: mark_integration_sync_clean clears the sync state on mergeable recovery but does not reset integration_conflict_total_dispatches.
  WHY: The function only clears the sync status and unresolved ticks, so a later real conflict can re-hit the lifetime cap immediately.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3387-3419 vs 3359-3368 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight merge probe duplicates the fetch and git merge-tree logic already implemented in _list_integration_conflict_files.
  WHY: Both code paths perform the same ref fetch and merge-tree check, which is inefficient and risks drift over time.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3406 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The self-capability check git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only --no-messages HEAD HEAD assumes HEAD is a valid tree-ish for merge-tree.
  WHY: On exotic runner states this probe could fail unexpectedly, although the flow fail-opens to dispatch.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3417 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The log message states the merge direction backwards.
  WHY: The echo text says the default branch merges into the integration branch, which can mislead operators during incident response.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
(No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3398-3419 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: git merge-tree invocations use only two tree-ish arguments after options, but git merge-tree requires three.
  WHY: The command fails with a syntax error and the probe always falls through to dispatch, even on clean merges.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3398-3419 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The probe simulates the wrong merge direction.
  WHY: The call checks integration onto default instead of default into integration, so clean sync merges can appear conflicted and trigger unnecessary dispatches.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3419 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The log message says the merge direction backwards.
  WHY: The echo text can mislead operators about which branch the probe is testing during incident response.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3389-3393 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: git merge-tree HEAD HEAD uses invalid two-arg syntax.
  WHY: The self-capability probe fails and the code falls through to the existing dispatch path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3465-3473 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: There is no timeout or counter on the _has_active_autofix_run deferral.
  WHY: A stuck autofix run can keep the cap check deferred until an external workflow timeout.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3403-3406 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: mark_integration_sync_clean clears state but leaves integration_conflict_total_dispatches intact.
  WHY: The cap check can re-fire immediately after recovery because the dispatch counter is not reset.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~3419 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The log message states the merge direction incorrectly.
  WHY: The echo text can mislead operators about which merge operation the pre-flight probe is testing.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3386-3423 and 3340-3378 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The pre-flight merge probe duplicates the git fetch and merge-tree logic already implemented in _list_integration_conflict_files.
  WHY: The probe and helper both fetch the same refs and run git merge-tree, causing an extra fetch per invocation that is inefficient but not a correctness issue.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
